name: qgis-mcp
description: Control QGIS from an AI assistant: inspect projects, manage layers, run processing algorithms, render maps, and execute PyQGIS code.
long_description: Connects an MCP client to a running QGIS instance through the WAI QGIS MCP plugin's socket server. Requires the WAI QGIS MCP plugin to be installed and started in QGIS (see https://github.com/wiseman/qgis_mcp). Everything else is bundled — no other software needed.

host.title: QGIS host
host.description: Host where the WAI QGIS MCP plugin's socket server is listening

port.title: QGIS port
port.description: Port of the WAI QGIS MCP plugin's socket server (set in the WAI QGIS MCP panel)
